import socket

def ping_daemon(host: str, port: int) -> bool:
    """Raw socket leak on socket error."""
    s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    s.connect((host, port))
    s.sendall(b'PING\n')
    resp = s.recv(1024)
    return b'PONG' in resp
